flow.title: Finish signing in in your browser
flow.browser_hint: A browser window is open. After you sign in or register, Lunarca continues automatically — there is nothing to paste or bring back.
flow.troubleshoot: Does the browser ask for a pairing code?
flow.code_hint: Enter this pairing code on the approval page:

password.mismatch: The two new passwords don’t match.
password.not_received_spam: Check your spam or Promotions folder; it comes from the address this server sends mail from.
password.not_received_spelling: Check the spelling: the code was sent to {{email}}.
password.invite_accept_desc: You've been invited to this server. Accept, then set a password you'll use with your email on any device.
password.set_desc: Choose a password only you know; you'll sign in with your email and it on any device. If you're resetting it, other devices will be signed out.
password.change_desc: Choose a new password. This device stays signed in; other devices will be signed out.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

session.title: Account
session.logout_local_only: Signed out on this device. Server sign-out is unconfirmed; revoke this device from another device.

lease_reason.no_pubkey: this build has no bundled verification key
lease_reason.unsupported_alg: this build does not support that signature algorithm

session.strict_local_blocked: Online account data isn't available while strict local is on. The identity below is cached on this device.

logout_confirm.title: Sign out?
logout_confirm.body: Cloud sync on this device stops right away; your local files aren’t affected. Signing back in to the same account resumes syncing automatically.

devices.title: Devices
devices.revoke_note: Revoked devices can no longer sync; content already on them stays.
devices.revoke_confirm_body: That device loses cloud access immediately and has to sign in again to get it back. Content already downloaded to it cannot be wiped remotely.
devices.over_limit: You are over your plan's device limit. Revoke a device you no longer use before signing in on a new one.

catalog.title: Downloadable model catalog
catalog.note: Refreshes the list of installable models without downloading, deleting or changing installed models.
catalog.prompts_degraded: Verified v{{version}} (effective for manifest v{{manifest}}; {{missing}} template(s) use bundled defaults){{variant}}
catalog.prompts_note: Prompts are signed and published by the server. Missing templates use bundled copies.
catalog.strict_local_note: Strict local is on, so network actions like catalog refresh are blocked. Turn it off under Settings › Privacy, then try again.

reason.bad_keys: the server's catalog signing credentials couldn't be verified
reason.keys_expired: the server's catalog signing credentials have expired (this recovers once the server renews them)
reason.keys_revoked: these catalog signing credentials were retired by the server and are no longer accepted
reason.rollback: server catalog version is older than the locally verified one (rollback protection)
reason.no_pubkey: this build has no catalog verification key
reason.no_active_catalog: no active catalog on the server
reason.invalid_endpoint: The server address is not a usable URL

catalog.refresh_schedule: Refreshes about every 6 hours while connected, right away when you sign in, and when you open this page or Apps if it has been more than 5 minutes. To check right away, click “Check for updates” in Apps.

export.desc: Export this account's records on the server (account, devices, subscription, billing and usage) as a JSON file. Your notes aren't in it: they live in your local vault; the server only stores the encrypted sync copy (the vault key is held in escrow for your account).

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: This cannot be undone: your account, devices and encrypted sync data are deleted from the server. To switch accounts, sign out instead.
delete.warning_short: Permanently deletes the server account and devices. Local notes, recordings and settings are kept.
delete.preview_failed: Couldn't load what deleting will change (subscription, prepaid balance, record retention): {{reason}} You can still delete.
delete.consequence_subscription: Your {{tier}} subscription is cancelled immediately; the current period is not refunded.
delete.consequence_credits: Your remaining {{credits}} credits are forfeited. Unused packs bought in the last 14 days can be refunded: contact support before you delete.
delete.consequence_retention: Billing and usage records are kept for {{count}} years for legal compliance, without your email.
delete.consequence_retention_one: Billing and usage records are kept for {{count}} year for legal compliance, without your email.
delete.consequence_local: Your notes and recordings on this device are not touched.

blocked.last_org_owner: You're the only owner of an organization that still has other members. Transfer ownership to another member, or ask an administrator to handle it, before deleting your account.

delete.export_first: Before deleting, consider exporting your account data.
delete.done: Account deleted. Billing and usage records are kept for {{count}} years for legal compliance, without your email; your notes and recordings on this device are untouched.
delete.done_one: Account deleted. Billing and usage records are kept for {{count}} year for legal compliance, without your email; your notes and recordings on this device are untouched.

error.needs_relogin: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.login_expired: This sign-in timed out. Please start again.
error.strict_local_blocked: Strict local mode blocked this network action.
error.invalid_endpoint: The server address is not a usable URL, so nothing was sent. It should look like https://host:port.
error.unreadable_response: {{host}} returned data this client version can't read. This usually means the client and server are on different versions — update both to the same one; the server itself is reachable.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
error.keychain: Could not read or write the system keychain, so this step did not finish. Make sure the login keychain is unlocked in Keychain Access, then try again; an unused invitation or code stays valid.
error.trust_anchor_changed: This server's signing keys changed, so the connection is paused. Compare the old and new keys under Account › Advanced › Server identity and confirm; until then Lunarca keeps using the keys it verified before.
error.trust_unsupported_format: This server's trust anchor format (v{{found}}) is newer than this client supports (v{{supported}}). Update Lunarca first.

network_kind.dns: {{host}} could not be found: the host name does not resolve.
network_kind.refused: {{host}} refused the connection: the host is reachable, but nothing is listening on that port.
network_kind.timeout: Connecting to {{host}} timed out: the host did not respond.
network_kind.tls: A secure connection to {{host}} could not be established: the certificate is not trusted.
network_kind.unreachable: Cannot reach {{host}}: this machine has no network route to it.

network_action.dns: Check the address for typos. Intranet host names must resolve on this machine; use the IP address if needed.
network_action.refused: Make sure the server is running and the port is correct.
network_action.timeout: Make sure this machine is on the same network as the server and no firewall blocks the port.
network_action.tls: This device doesn't trust this server's certificate. Just sign in with your email and password: sign-in verifies it and trusts it for this server only. If the server changed its certificate, sign in once more. Lunarca has no option to skip certificate checks.
network_action.unreachable: Make sure this machine is on the same network as the server. For a server on your local network, also allow Lunarca under macOS System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network.
network_action.other: Make sure the server is running, the address is correct and this machine can reach it.

server_action.gateway: The reverse proxy is reachable, but the Lunarca server behind it did not respond. Ask your administrator to check that the server process is running.
server_action.not_found: There is no Lunarca server at this address: the port or path may be wrong. Check the address with your administrator.
server_action.forbidden: The server refused the anonymous probe, usually because the reverse proxy adds extra authentication. Ask your administrator to allow /inference/v1/capabilities.
server_action.other: Try again later; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator the HTTP status code.

login_rejected.invalid_credentials: The email, password or one-time code isn't right (the code may also have expired or been used). After several wrong tries, wait a moment before trying again.
login_rejected.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact your administrator.
login_rejected.organization_archived: Your organization has been archived. Contact your administrator.
login_rejected.password_invalid: The new password doesn’t meet the requirements: 8 to 128 characters and different from the current one.

error.already_signed_in: You are already signed in. Only one account can be signed in at a time; sign out first to switch servers.
error.not_an_address: Paste the invite link from your administrator, or enter a server address (for example https://ai.example.com:8443).

link_rejected.not_connect_link: This is not a Lunarca invite link.
link_rejected.unsupported_version: This invite link uses a newer format than this version supports. Update Lunarca first.
link_rejected.missing: This invite link is incomplete. Ask your administrator for a new one.
link_rejected.bad_server: The server address in this invite link is invalid. Check with your administrator.

error.client_too_old: This server requires a newer Lunarca (protocol ≥ v{{min_client_protocol}}). Update Lunarca before signing in.
error.server_too_old: This server runs an older version (protocol v{{server_protocol}}) that is not compatible with this Lunarca. Ask your administrator to upgrade the server.
error.no_invite: This invitation has already been used. Sign in with your email and password, or ask your admin for a new invitation.
error.billing_disabled: This server doesn't sell plans online. Ask your administrator if you need more quota.
error.plan_unavailable: That item is no longer on sale. The price list has been reloaded; please choose again.
error.no_billing_account: This account hasn't paid for anything on this server yet, so there is no subscription to manage.
error.billing_unavailable: The subscription couldn't be cancelled right now, so nothing was deleted: your account, subscription and data are all still there. Please try again later.
error.export_write_failed: The export couldn't be written to the chosen location, and no partial file was left behind. Try a different location.
error.last_org_owner: You're the only owner of an organization that still has other members, so nothing was deleted. Transfer ownership to another member, or ask an administrator to handle it, before deleting your account.
error.account_frozen: Your account is read-only because of a payment dispute: purchases are unavailable and cloud inference and sync uploads are paused. Your data is not affected. Please contact support.
error.spend_cap_reached: You've reached the monthly prepaid spending cap you set; subscription-included quota isn't affected.
error.invalid_spend_cap: Enter a cap of 0 or more.
error.free_quota_withheld: This account can't receive free quota right now; prepaid credits and paid plans still work. See Account › Subscription & usage for why and what to do.
error.verification_not_required: This account no longer needs payment verification. The page has been reloaded.
error.device_limit_expired: The chance to remove a device for this sign-in has expired or was already used. Please sign in again.
error.email_domain_not_allowed: Please sign up with an everyday email address: this email domain isn't accepted (for example, disposable addresses).
error.server_identity_rejected: Your password matched, but the identity this server sent can't be trusted (most likely you reached a different server). Nothing was saved. Check the server address and try again.

spend_cap.title: Monthly prepaid cap
spend_cap.heading: Monthly prepaid cap · resets {{date}}
spend_cap.hint: The cap only applies to what's drawn from prepaid credits; subscription-included quota is never blocked by it. Once it's reached, tasks that need prepaid credits won't start, and running ones stop where they are — output so far is kept and billed for what was actually used. Counted per calendar month (UTC).

free_quota.title: Free quota
free_quota.shared_device: Another account has already received free quota on this device. Free quota goes to one account per device, so this account can't receive it here. Prepaid credits and paid plans are not affected and work as usual.
free_quota.shared_device_appeal: If you think this is a mistake, contact support to appeal. An appeal never requires you to share any additional personal information.
free_quota.verification_required: Verify a payment method once to receive free quota. Verification charges nothing and starts no subscription; it only helps prevent abuse. Prepaid credits and paid plans are not affected.
free_quota.verify_opened: The verification page is open in your browser. Come back to Lunarca when you're done and this page will refresh.

estimate.note: This is an estimate; the final bill follows the server's metering.

quota.title: Not enough quota for this task
quota.body: Based on the estimate, your remaining subscription quota and prepaid credits won't cover this task. To avoid failing halfway, it hasn't started. Add quota and try again, or switch to an on-device model.

spend_cap.title: This would go over your monthly prepaid cap
spend_cap.body: Based on the estimate, this task would draw on prepaid credits, and this month's prepaid spending is already close to the cap you set. To avoid stopping halfway, it hasn't started. Raise the cap and try again, or switch to an on-device model.

entitlements.capabilities_hint: Set by your organization on the server you signed in to; anything not enabled runs on this device.
entitlements.capabilities_none: None enabled (everything runs on this device)

sync.title: Sync
sync.held_deletions: {{count}} file deletions are waiting for your confirmation (sync stops first when many files are deleted at once).
sync.conflict_copies: The last round created {{count}} conflict copies. Both versions are kept.
sync.too_large: {{count}} files are too large to sync: {{names}}. Everything else keeps syncing.

phase.unavailable: Vault not found (disk disconnected or moved)

confirm_delete.title: Continue syncing these deletions in “{{name}}”?
confirm_delete.body_count: This round deletes {{count}} files, and the deletions reach all your devices. Deleted files can still be restored from version history and the trash.
confirm_delete.body_empty: One side became completely empty. Continuing deletes the matching files on the other side. Continue only if this is what you meant.

disable.title: Stop syncing “{{name}}”?
disable.body: Stop syncing on this device. Local files and the cloud vault are both kept, and other devices keep syncing. You can join again later.

wizard.title: Sync “{{name}}”
wizard.point_account: Sign in to the same account on another device to join.
wizard.point_scope: Syncs vault notes, attachments, recordings, vault settings, and sidecars. Other hidden files and files outside the vault are excluded.
wizard.point_encrypted: Encrypted on this device before upload. Vault keys are account-managed, and the sync service can unwrap them.
wizard.point_metadata: The server can see file counts, sizes and modification times.
wizard.choice_new: Create a cloud vault and upload this vault
wizard.loading_vaults: Loading cloud vaults on your account…
wizard.new_desc: Upload to a new remote vault.
wizard.join_desc: Merge local and selected remote vaults. Files unique to either side are copied across; differing files with the same name produce conflict copies.
wizard.upload_size: This vault is about {{size}} and will be encrypted and uploaded.
wizard.over_capacity: This vault is about {{size}}, more than the {{remaining}} left in the cloud. Uploading stops at the limit and resumes once you free up space or upgrade.

error.sync_strict_local: Sync is unavailable in strict local mode.
error.sync_not_entitled: Your subscription does not include sync.
error.sync_already_enabled: Sync is already on for this vault. Turn it off before switching to another cloud vault.
error.sync_not_enabled: Sync is not on for this vault.
error.sync_keychain: Could not use the system keychain, so the sync key was not saved.
error.sync_state_db: Could not read or write the local sync state.
error.sync_remote_corrupt: Cloud data could not be decrypted or is damaged. Your local files were not changed.
error.sync_unavailable: The sync service is not running.
error.sync_not_bound: Sync is not on for this vault.
error.sync_identity_mismatch: The open vault does not match the sync record, so sync stopped to avoid writing to the wrong place.
error.sync_keys_missing: This device has no sync key. Fetching it again from your account.
error.sync_local_looks_empty: The local vault suddenly looks empty (an external drive may be unmounted or the folder replaced). Sync is paused and nothing was deleted in the cloud.
error.sync_remote_looks_empty: The cloud vault suddenly looks empty. Sync is paused and nothing was deleted locally.
error.sync_local_io: Error reading or writing local files. Retrying next round.
error.sync_epoch_changed: The cloud vault was just reset. The next round will reconcile.
error.sync_cursor_expired: Offline for too long. The next round will reconcile.
error.sync_read_only: The cloud vault is read-only: downloads work, uploads are paused.
error.sync_quota_exceeded: Sync storage is full: downloads work, uploads are paused.
error.account_frozen: Your account is read-only: downloads work, uploads are paused.
error.sync_storage_unavailable: Server storage is unavailable. Retrying automatically.
error.sync_vault_key_exists: This cloud vault already has a key.
error.not_found: This vault was not found in the cloud.
error.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Sync continues once you are online.
error.sync_no_managed_key: This cloud vault's key is not held by your account, so it can't be joined on this device.
error.sync_key_escrow_unavailable: The server can't provide the vault key right now. Retrying automatically.
error.sync_vault_unavailable: Can't open this vault's folder (disk disconnected or moved).
error.sync_remote_in_use: Another vault on this device already syncs with this cloud vault.
error.sync_bound_elsewhere: This vault is connected to another account. To sync it with the current account, confirm “Sync to this account instead” first.
error.sync_folder_unavailable: The selected folder can’t be opened.
error.sync_folder_inside_vault: That location is inside a notes vault, and a vault can't go inside another. Choose a different location.
error.sync_manage_forbidden: Only the organization’s owners and admins can delete or restore its cloud vaults.
error.sync_restore_over_capacity: Restoring would exceed your cloud storage. Free up space or upgrade, then restore.
error.sync_restore_expired: The restore period is over and this cloud vault has been permanently removed.
error.vault_deleted: This cloud vault was deleted, so this device stopped syncing it. Your local files are all here.

sync.choose_desc: Sync selected vaults, including vaults that are not open.
sync.strict_local: Sync is unavailable in strict local mode.
sync.read_only_grace: Cloud sync is read-only: you can download but not upload changes. Cloud copies are removed on {{date}} unless you renew; notes on this Mac are not affected.
sync.account_frozen: Your account is read-only because of a payment dispute: sync uploads are paused and downloads continue. Your local changes are kept and will upload once it is resolved.

restore.open: Restore to a point in time…
restore.title: Restore “{{name}}” to a point in time
restore.desc: Restores into a new folder next to the vault; the current vault is not changed. Afterwards you can open it side by side to compare.
restore.state_at: Restores the vault as it was at {{time}}.
restore.before_first: Nothing had been synced yet at that time; the folder will be empty.
restore.expired: That point is beyond the history retention period. Pick a more recent time.
restore.skipped: {{count}} files could not be decrypted and were skipped.

sync.no_vaults: There are no vaults on this device yet.

pause_all.paused_until: All syncing is paused and resumes automatically at {{time}}.
pause_all.paused_indefinitely: All syncing is paused until you resume it.

storage.title: Cloud storage
storage.desc: Encrypted data of every cloud vault on your account, including version history.
storage.desc_unlinked: Includes version history. {{size}} belongs to remote vaults not synced on this device.
storage.full: Cloud storage is full: synced content can still be downloaded and deleted, but new changes stop uploading. Syncing resumes once you free up space or upgrade.

large_paused.metered: On a metered network: recordings and other large files wait, notes keep syncing. They resume on an unmetered network.
large_paused.low_battery: Battery is low: recordings and other large files wait, notes keep syncing. They resume once you plug in.

sync.other_account: On this device, this vault is connected to another account, so the current account doesn’t sync it. Syncing resumes when that account signs back in.

take_over.title: Sync “{{name}}” to this account instead?
take_over.body: This vault’s contents will be uploaded to the current account. The original account’s cloud vault is kept, and this device stops syncing with it.

cloud_vaults.title: Cloud vaults
cloud_vaults.desc: All cloud vaults on your account, including ones that aren’t on this device.
cloud_vaults.empty: Your account has no cloud vaults yet.
cloud_vaults.downloaded: Downloading to {{path}}. Stay online until sync finishes.
cloud_vaults.restored: Restored. Download or join it again on the devices that need it.
cloud_vaults.deleted_desc: Deleted cloud vaults don’t count toward your storage. Restore them before the date shown; after that they’re permanently removed.
cloud_vaults.purge_due: Restore period is over; permanent removal is pending

delete_dialog.title: Delete the cloud vault “{{name}}”?
delete_dialog.body: Every device stops syncing this vault. Local files on every device are kept. You can restore it here within 30 days; after that it’s permanently removed.
delete_dialog.prompt: Type the vault name “{{text}}” to confirm:
delete_dialog.prompt_unreadable: This vault’s name isn’t readable yet. Type its ID “{{text}}” to confirm:
delete_dialog.input_label: Text to type to confirm deletion

cloud_vaults.pick_parent: Choose where to put it: a "{{name}}" folder will be created inside
cloud_vaults.pick_parent_unnamed: Choose where to put it: a new folder for this cloud vault will be created inside

signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: When you sign in, AI and sync come from the server you sign in to. Without signing in, everything on this device still works, and your notes and recordings always stay here.
signin.remembered: Signing in to the server you used last time: {{name}}
signin.incoming: Join "{{name}}": enter your email to continue.
signin.strict_local: Strict local mode turns off all network actions. Turn it off in Privacy settings to sign in.
signin.no_method: This server has no sign-in method enabled. Contact your administrator.
signin.use_default_server: Pick the server from my email
signin.server_placeholder: https://host:port, or the lunarca:// link from your admin
signin.sso_needs_config: You haven't signed in to this server on this device yet, so its single sign-on options aren't visible before sign-in. For single sign-on, import the organization config file from your admin; signing in with a password or one-time code needs nothing extra.

advanced.title: Advanced: server identity and organization config

billing.title: Plans & credits

standing.past_due: Your payment failed. Update your payment method by {{date}}, or your account will move to the free plan. Service continues and your local data is not affected.
standing.frozen: Your account is read-only because of a payment dispute: cloud inference and sync uploads are paused and your data is not affected. Please contact support. Purchases are unavailable until it is resolved.

billing.manage_hint: Change plans, update your payment method or cancel on Stripe's billing page. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period by default.
billing.switch_hint: You already have a subscription. To change plans, use Manage subscription so you don't end up paying for two.
billing.tier_unknown_hint: Your current plan couldn't be loaded, so subscribing is hidden for now. Refresh to try again.
billing.opened: The payment page is open in your browser. Come back to Lunarca when you're done and this page will refresh; confirmation can take a moment.
billing.portal_opened: The billing page is open in your browser. This page refreshes when you come back to Lunarca.
billing.empty: This server has no plans or credit packs on sale right now.

rules.order: Order of use: {{order}}. The next balance is only used once the previous one runs out; quota is exhausted only when all are empty.
rules.no_split: Each task is charged to a single balance as a whole; it is never split between them.
rules.split: A single task may be split between balances.
rules.prepaid_never_expires: Prepaid credits never expire and don't reset.
rules.minimum_unit: {{dimension}}: billed in units of {{unit}}; anything less rounds up to {{unit}}.

device_limit.title: Device limit reached ({{max}} devices)
device_limit.desc: This account can be signed in on up to {{max}} devices at once. Remove one you no longer use and this device will finish signing in.
device_limit.note: The removed device is signed out and loses cloud features; notes and recordings stored on it are not deleted.
device_limit.remove: Remove this one and sign in
device_limit.expires: Choose before {{time}}; after that you'll need to sign in again.
device_limit.again: Another device just took the open slot. Please choose one more.

code.reset_desc: We'll send a one-time code to {{email}}. Enter it to set a new password.
code.signup_desc: We'll send a verification code to {{email}}. Enter it and set a password to create your account.
code.signup_consent: By creating an account, you agree to the Lunarca Cloud Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
code.have_code_desc: Enter the one-time code from your admin or from the email (case and dashes don't matter).
code.sent: If {{email}} can use this server, the code is on its way. Enter it and set a new password to sign in.
code.not_received_reset: If this server doesn't send email, ask your admin to issue a one-time code from the console.
